campaign.title: Direct M9-M1 hard and smooth parent minimax gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use only primary reciprocal-sum or product-phase sources after matching the literal M1 profile, pointwise norm, real-X endpoints, and hard/smooth owner. A global theorem is not a blockwise owner without an exact inverse-localization lemma.

frozen_target.question: After every accepted direct owner is removed, what is the exact separate minimax capacity of the hard and smooth M9-M1 physical parents, and does any accepted theorem or literal adjacent-profile identity shrink either parent?
frozen_target.reference_formula: B_1(D,L;X)=sum_(h asymp L)Phi(h/(H_D+1))h^(-1) sum_(d asymp D)chi_4(d)w_D(d)e(hX/d), with residual U_1={ell<delta-1/4,178ell+1638delta>463} minus {(1/2,0)}. Direct bounds are 1+D/L, 1+sqrt(LX/D)+D^(3/2)/sqrt(LX), and the audited TTY exponent [89(1+ell)+819delta]/1282. The hard transformed parent has target L^(3/2) and coefficient-blind capacity L^2.
quantities: accepted owner priority bottom, R5-Full, terminal, full second derivative, TTY, then residual U_1

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact direct physical owner partition and residual U_1 without adding a global-route summand.
Minimize every accepted direct bound separately on the hard and smooth literal parent sets, including the TTY row and its scope.
Verify the hard and first-smooth critical label families, actual dyadic frequency availability, floors, stars, support crossings, and prior-owner exclusions.
Translate the hard critical physical capacity into the normalized L^2 versus L^(3/2) cone ledger without dropping literal weights.
Test whether the hard and first-smooth profiles have any exact adjacent-profile cancellation or whether they remain separate owner leaves.
Distinguish menu optimality from an arithmetic lower bound and a pointwise theorem from a stronger Gram or global aggregate.
Prove a strict parent improvement, a newly target-safe subrange, an exact connector gain, or a rigorous separate-parent minimax/no-go with the smallest critical survivors.
State exactly what would follow for M9-M1, M9, the global exponent, and the alternative GAR route.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact separate hard/smooth direct-menu minimax, verify the literal critical labels, and identify any lawful shrink or the first exact obstruction.
excluded_context: all Round-91, Round-98, and Round-119 nonblind artifacts
required_output: The exact separate minimax and literal witness families, or a proved shrink.
A hard/smooth owner and capacity table.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Minimize the exact accepted capacity separately on the hard and smooth direct M1 parents, test adjacent-profile or owner gains, and isolate the smallest critical survivors.
required_output: Exact hard and smooth capacity functions and minimax witnesses.
Any proved parent shrink, or the smallest literal critical survivors and missing powers.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit the separate-parent minimax, literal label ownership, any adjacent-profile connector, and every claimed implication from direct, canonical, global, or source estimates.
required_output: A pass/fail table for owner, minimax, literal labels, normalization, connector, source, and implication seams.
The maximal safe minimax/no-go statement or a fatal correction.

review_seams.requirement: The bottom, R5, terminal, second-derivative, TTY, hard, and smooth owners are disjoint and exhaustive on the direct route.
Every accepted row is minimized on the correct literal parent set and compared with X^(1/4).
Hard and first-smooth X^(1/6) frequency families exist with floors, dyadic support, stars, and real-X crossings retained.
The physical hard block and normalized L^2 versus L^(3/2) cone ledger use the accepted transform constants and target-safe errors.
Any adjacent-profile cancellation is coefficientwise and owner-preserving; a shared exponent deficit is not an identity.
Canonical Gram and GAR implications follow only proved graph edges; menu optimality is not an actual lower bound.
No M9-M1, M9, exponent, or quarter promotion occurs unless the full required parent conjunction is proved.
